title: The N-2 property ascends along a quasi-finite extension of Noetherian domains
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a quasi-finite extension of domains over a Noetherian N-2 base is again N-2 (statement lines 45418-45422). The proof does not argue with the definition of quasi-finiteness directly: it notes that the induced fraction field extension is finite, applies the N-2 property of the base to it, passes to a suitable intermediate ring where finiteness of the integral closure can be transferred, and finishes using transitivity of integral closure and permanence of finiteness (proof lines 45424-45449). Choosing the intermediate ring so that the transfer applies is the content. H2.
